title: I draw comics.
paragraphs: I am Milton Aguiar, a comic book artist from Portugal. I pencil, ink and colour: covers, interior pages, pin-ups and commissions.
Batman is the character that made me want to draw comics, and the reason I made a hero of my own. That hero is Raptor, the book I am drawing now.
I co-founded ImaginAction Comics, where Raptor is published, and I animate a little on the side.
